aperture.method: Convex hull of full-resolution primary scan vertices at Z >= 0.5 mm within OPEN-MAIN eroded 3 mm, simplified 0.25 mm, then offset 1.75 mm. Sweeps all captured forward hardware for axial insertion; excludes opening edge stone. No fitted hardware is moved. Triangle check follows.
aperture.not_claimed: Hidden geometry, physically bounded scan accuracy, cartridge removal through installed plate, or actual foam footprint.

requested_shop_notes.quantity: One main plus one matching diverter; choose A or B, do not make all options by default
requested_shop_notes.xy_tolerance_basis: Requested target consistent with published +/-0.005 inch laser cutting; vendor must confirm for chosen process
requested_shop_notes.flatness_status: Requested global maximum for quote review; not a factory foam specification or vendor promise
requested_shop_notes.edges: Deburr both faces and cutout; remove tabs and sharp edges. No resizing of critical contours without drawing revision.
requested_shop_notes.finish: Visible face uniform satin / directional brush, same direction on both parts; protect face during cutting and shipping. Stainless will not exactly match Kohler Vibrant Brushed Nickel. Obtain finish sample before cosmetic release.
requested_shop_notes.thickness: Use listed stock thickness, report actual range and final thickness after finishing; do not quietly substitute nominal gauge.
requested_shop_notes.holes: One central through aperture per plate; no mounting holes, threads, countersinks or decorative-cover stud holes.
requested_shop_notes.retention: Trial: clamped by retained factory plate assembly/foam with controlled support on stone; centering jig required. Adhesive alone is not a structural retention specification.
requested_shop_notes.service: Backing plate removable with trim. Preserve factory drain path. Cartridge/stop work may require backing-plate removal.
requested_shop_notes.release: Hold permanent manufacture until fit, support, foam path, hardware adjustment, material/finish and owner release are recorded.
